overrides.value: A Zotero plugin for Chinese-language literature: metadata retrieval, local attachment matching, Chinese translators and citation styles, and PDF bookmark and outline management.
overrides.reason: Condensed from the opening paragraph of doc/README-en.md, the English README. The upstream has no description fully in English: the manifest is in Chinese, and the GitHub About text pairs a short English sentence with a Chinese one, so its CJK share is 0.5 or more.
